integrity: The theorem is supported by an all-size argument and a replayable finite checker; independent external audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The classification is for finite loop-decorated ordinal sums of antichains, not all finite temporal Heyting algebras; the congruence/archival correspondence is cited from prior work, finite checks are not infinite proofs, and historical priority is not exhaustively settled.
title: Congruence-lattice normal form and rarity laws for layered temporal Heyting algebras
